You are auditing the Astro marketing site at /Users/egortokarev/Code/voxfusion/packages/marketingsite for a macOS voice-transcription app called VoxFusion. Read ALL files: src/pages/*.astro, src/components/*.astro, src/layouts/, src/i18n/, src/seo.ts, astro.config.mjs, Dockerfile, nginx.conf, public/, package.json.

Find every meaningful improvement opportunity:

1. **SEO**: missing/duplicate meta tags, canonical URLs, hreflang for i18n pages, structured data (SoftwareApplication schema), sitemap generation, robots.txt correctness, og image correctness (both og.svg and og.png exist — which is referenced?), title/description quality per page.
2. **Performance**: render-blocking resources, unoptimized images/SVGs, missing font-display/preload, inline script size in index.astro (777 lines — how much is shipped JS?), missing compression/cache headers in nginx.conf, missing Astro image optimization, unused CSS/JS shipped.
3. **Accessibility**: heading hierarchy, contrast, alt text, keyboard nav for interactive elements (download dropdowns etc.), prefers-reduced-motion for animations, focus styles.
4. **i18n**: how the site handles locales vs the app's 7 locales (en/de/es/fr/it/ru/zh), untranslated strings, lang attributes, locale routing.
5. **Content/conversion UX**: download flow clarity (Downloads.astro — architecture detection? Apple Silicon vs Intel), CTA placement, missing pages (changelog? FAQ? support contact?), 404 page usefulness, footer links validity, claims consistency with the actual product (it's a local-first offline Whisper transcription app), privacy/terms/security page quality and consistency (do they contradict each other or the app's actual telemetry — the app bundles PostHog analytics, check whether the privacy policy discloses that).
6. **Infra**: Dockerfile efficiency (multi-stage? layer caching?), nginx.conf security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options), caching policy, whether robots/sitemap match astro.config site URL.

For EVERY finding give: `file:line`, one-sentence problem statement, one-sentence concrete fix, severity (high/medium/low). Order by severity. Verify each claim against actual file contents (quote the offending line). Be exhaustive but concrete. Your final message is the deliverable: a markdown findings list, nothing else.

# VoxFusion Marketing Site Audit — Findings Verified against source and a fresh production build (`astro build` succeeds; output: 6 pages, 3 CSS files, ~0 KB of first-party framework JS). All paths below are under `/Users/egortokarev/Code/voxfusion/` unless absolute. Note on the 777-line `index.astro`: it ships **zero JavaScript** — lines 198–777 are scoped CSS compiled to an external 8.8 KB stylesheet (`dist/_astro/index.3hI7rIkh.css`). The only JS shipped site-wide is the Umami loader + ~1 KB inline tracker, plus a tiny mobile-menu module on `/download`. ## HIGH 1. **`packages/marketingsite/src/i18n/ru/hero.ts:9-11`** — Homepage stat claims `"hero.stat.languages.value": "0"` / `"hero.stat.languages.label": "data sent to servers"`, but the app ships PostHog telemetry to `https://eu.i.posthog.com` (`packages/app/src/lib/posthog.ts:5-6`) and the site itself sends Umami events (`src/components/Umami.astro:18`), so "0 data sent to servers" is factually false. Fix: change the stat to "0 audio sent to servers" (matching the carefully-scoped claims elsewhere) and keep "no audio leaves your device" language. Severity: high. 2. **`packages/marketingsite/src/i18n/ru/hero.ts:6` + `features.ts:8` + `src/pages/index.astro:83`** — The site instructs "Press Cmd+;" ("Press Cmd+;, speak naturally…", "Press Cmd+; anywhere on your Mac", terminal mock "Listening on Cmd+;"), but the app's actual default hotkey is `LeftControl+LeftOption` (`packages/app/src/lib/hotkeyUtils.ts:44: export const DEFAULT_HOTKEY = "LeftControl+LeftOption";`). Fix: update all three strings to the real default (Ctrl+Option) or make the app default match the marketing. Severity: high. 3. **`packages/marketingsite/nginx.conf:1-21`** — The server block sets zero security headers (no `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options`/`frame-ancestors`, `Referrer-Policy`, `Strict-Transport-Security`, `Content-Security-Policy`, `Permissions-Policy`). Fix: add a hardened header set (e.g. `add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always;` etc., with a CSP allowing `cloud.umami.is` and `fonts.googleapis.com`/`fonts.gstatic.com`), remembering `add_header` inside the static-asset `location` (line 11) suppresses inherited headers so they must be repeated there. Severity: high. 4. **`packages/marketingsite/src/i18n/ru/terms.ts:19` vs `LICENSE:1-3` and `src/pages/index.astro:63`** — Terms prohibit "decompiling, disassembling, or otherwise attempting to extract the source code… or using the Service to create a competing product," yet the product is MIT-licensed ("MIT License… VoxFusion contributors") and the homepage links straight to the public GitHub repo — the Terms directly contradict the granted license. Fix: rewrite §2.2 to defer to the MIT license (or dual-license intentionally). Severity: high. 5. **`packages/marketingsite/src/i18n/ru/features.ts:11,22`** — "No internet required after install" and "100% offline transcription after install" are inaccurate: Whisper/Parakeet models are downloaded *after* install from Hugging Face (`packages/app/src-tauri/src/handlers/models.rs:54: url: "https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin"`). Fix: say "after the one-time model download" or "works fully offline once the model is downloaded." Severity: high. 6. **`packages/marketingsite/src/i18n/ru/privacy.ts:23-27` (§3) — analytics disclosure is incomplete**: the policy discloses only that "the app may send anonymous events" and a generic "third-party analytics provider" (§6.2), but (a) it never mentions the *website's* Umami analytics at all, and (b) PostHog persists a `distinct_id` in localStorage (`packages/app/src/lib/posthog.ts:34: persistence: "localStorage"`), a persistent pseudonymous device identifier that sits uneasily with "no information that personally identifies you." Fix: name PostHog (EU-hosted) and Umami, disclose the persistent identifier, and add an opt-out. Severity: high. ## MEDIUM 7. **`packages/marketingsite/src/layouts/Layout.astro` (whole file)** — Layout.astro is imported by **no page** (all six pages hand-roll their own ``), so its mail.ru site-verification tag (`Layout.astro:25: `) and Inter font never ship — verification is silently broken and the file is 96 lines of dead code. Fix: either fold pages into this layout (also fixing finding #14) and keep the verification meta, or delete the file and move the meta into the shared head. Severity: medium. 8. **`packages/marketingsite/Dockerfile:5-8`** — `COPY package.json bun.lock* turbo.json tsconfig.json ./` + `COPY packages/marketingsite/package.json …` then `RUN bun install` omits `packages/app/package.json` even though the root workspace is `packages/*` and `bun.lock` was resolved with both workspaces, so installs are non-reproducible (and can fail on lockfile/workspace mismatch); `--frozen-lockfile` is also missing.
